title: CBSE Class 10 Science
summary: CBSE Class 10 Science board questions, 2022 to 2026, five a day. Questions the board asked again in another year come first, highest count first, then the question types it keeps asking, then every other question. A case study counts as one question.
note: Repeats are counted across years: the bank keeps one row for a question that several sets of one year shared. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF.md) and checked.
